Details
  • Paper: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale, ICLR 2021, 2020-10-22
  • Paper: How to train your ViT? Data, Augmentation, and Regularization in Vision Transformers, TMLR 2022, 2021-06-18
  • Original code: https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models at 0df212b369a5
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/google-research/vision_transformer (JAX): The authors' code is JAX; timm's PyTorch port carries the converted AugReg weights (further fine-tuned by timm).
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files:
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/timm/vit_base_patch16_224.augreg2_in21k_ft_in1k/blob/063c6c38a5d8510b2e57df480445e94b231dad2c/README.md
  • Training data: ImageNet-21k / ImageNet-22k (full ImageNet, fall 2011 release), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: vit_base_patch16_224.augreg2_in21k_ft_in1k (default of vit_base_patch16_224)
  • Outputs: logits; label_set: imagenet-1k
  • Input size: fixed 224x224: the input is resized (short side 248) and centre-cropped to it
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): vit_base_patch16_224.augreg2_in21k_ft_in1k 224x224 (0.2 GiB peak allocated, 0.3 reserved)
  • vit_base_patch16_224.augreg2_in21k_ft_in1k 224x224, first call: portable + torch.compile 7 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 29 s (ONNX + engine).
  • vit_base_patch16_224.augreg2_in21k_ft_in1k original 224x224: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
  • vit_base_patch16_224.augreg2_in21k_ft_in1k load / first call: original 2.49 s / 0.283 s, portable 0.73 s / 0.004 s, kernels 2.05 s / 0.069 s
  • Protocol, median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input (synthetic for bench_inputs sizes), card defaults; gc before each load; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls

Measured

fastforks: the model's own resize / crop on the GPU; original: the library's pretrained loader and its PIL eval transform. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.
